items.title: FOSDEM PGDay 2027: two days of PostgreSQL, with calls for papers and sponsors now open!
items.summary: Join us for FOSDEM PGDay 2027 on January 28 and 29 at the Brussels Marriott Hotel Grand Place.This year, we're expanding to two days, bringing you more PostgreSQL talks and more time to connect with fellow enthusiasts from around the world. Start your FOSDEM trip with dedicated PostgreSQL content, then enjoy the main FOSDEM event over the weekend!- New for 2027: sponsor the event -For the first time, we're offering sponsorship opportunities for FOSDEM PGDay!Our Platinum, Gold and Silver packages offer different ways to get involved. Platinum and Gold packages include an exhibition desk and a sponsor-track talk.Explore the sponsorship opportunities and find the right package for you.- Call for Papers -Our Call for Papers is now open! Talks will be 45 minutes, followed by time for questions, and must be presented in English. Selected speakers receive free admission to the conference.Read the Call for Papers and submit your proposal by 2026-12-01 23:59:59 CET.We look forward to seeing you in Brussels for two days of PostgreSQL!
